input.encoding: [mode, text_length, key_length, text ASCII bytes..., key ASCII bytes...]
input.valid_text_and_key: ASCII A-Z or a-z; both are uppercased
input.key_schedule: repeat the key for each text character; key letter pairs A/B through Y/Z select the 13 Porta tableaus
input.mode_1: apply the same reciprocal Porta tableau
input.empty_key_rule: empty key is valid only for empty text
input.output_encoding: uppercase ASCII letters without NUL terminator
